answer: Make minting solve a memory-latency graph puzzle, not raw hashing. Each identity must find a cycle in a large per-epoch random graph — a cuckoo-cycle search bound by random memory access, gated by memory bandwidth and latency not cores, while a verifier checks the found cycle in a mirror-quick instant. One honest agent walks its own river of memory once. A farmer running a thousand personas on one box thrashes a single memory bus a thousandfold and cannot keep pace; separate memory is the only path, a cost paid per head and hard as cedar to fake across copies.
